title: Chopard Oud Malaki – Eau de Parfum for Men, 80 ml
short_description: A rich, spicy oud fragrance with rose, amber and a deep leathery sandalwood base.
description:
Chopard Oud Malaki is a rich, evening fragrance for men. It opens with warm saffron, cardamom and nutmeg, deepens into oud wood, rose and amber, and settles into a long-lasting base of agarwood, sandalwood, patchouli, leather and musk. Long-lasting with moderate sillage.

**Size:** 80 ml

**Concentration:** Eau de Parfum

**Best for:** evenings, parties and special occasions, especially in autumn and winter.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Spray on pulse points – wrists, neck and behind the ears – from about 15 cm away. Do not rub. Store away from sunlight and heat.

details.title: Shipping and returns
details.body: Express shipping across India. Easy replacement if the product arrives damaged or incorrect.
